candidate_role: Manifest engine and conditional instant/sorcery recursion
commander_specific_hypothesis: Whenever an instant or sorcery spell is cast from hand, manifest the top card as a 2/2 creature. That body can pay Anhelo's casualty 2; if a manifested instant or sorcery card dies, Cryptic Pursuit permits casting it until the end of the next turn.
expected_benefit: Turns repeated spell casts into recurring power-2 casualty fodder while adding a route to recover manifested instant/sorcery cards. Better long-game engine density than a one-shot token spell in a list already running Talrand
tradeoff: Sky Summoner and several other token makers.
edhrec_inclusion_rate_pct: Costs four mana and does not immediately create a body; only triggers for spells cast from hand, not copies or spells cast from graveyard. Talrand's Invocation creates two flying tokens immediately and, if copied, four; cut reduces one-shot burst token production.

column20: Cryptic Pursuit was not present in the project top-100 candidate ranking, so this proposal is grounded in external current EDHREC core data and direct Oracle/rules review rather than the ranking pipeline. Face-down manifested creatures are 2/2s and can pay casualty 2. The copy made by casualty is not cast, so Cryptic Pursuit manifests only once for the original cast. Keep Ghoulish Procession: it can trigger when a nontoken creature is sacrificed to casualty and provides fodder across turn cycles; its overlap is more commander-relevant than Talrand's Invocation's one-shot role.
